name: Wyoming Fabrication & Machine
old_description: When it comes to steel fabrication services, rely on a company that has been in this business since 1990. Whether you require straightforward steel fabrication or custom work that's one of a kind, we're the team you can count on.
about:
Wyoming Fabrication & Machine has operated from Evanston, Wyoming since 1990. The company was founded that year and has served the region’s steel fabrication needs for over three decades. No founders or ownership structure are disclosed in public materials.

The shop provides a range of steel services including custom steel design, fabrication, equipment repair, and protective coating. Beyond fabrication, it offers machining, demolition, scrap steel removal, and maintains a stock steel inventory for direct sales. The company describes its team as skilled and well-equipped, though facility size and headcount are not published.

The company’s primary market is the construction industry, which it has served since its founding. Customers include contractors and builders requiring structural steel, repairs, and related services such as demolition and scrap removal.

Wyoming Fabrication & Machine distinguishes itself by bundling fabrication with complementary services such as machining, demolition, and scrap removal, allowing clients to source multiple steel-related needs from a single provider. The addition of stock steel sales further supports quick-turnaround projects.
